summary: Backend-only testing for Arabic Pharmacy Cashier App. Created /app/backend/tests/test_pharmacy_api.py with 29 pytest cases covering auth (pharmacy + supplier), JWT /me, medicines CRUD + barcode + buy/sell flows, orders, supplier products + marketplace, role enforcement (403), and AI Gemini-3-Flash identify endpoint. All 29/29 tests passed (100%).

minor.issue: JWT_SECRET in /app/backend/.env is 28 bytes - jwt library logs InsecureKeyLengthWarning (RFC 7518 recommends >=32 bytes for HS256). Functional but should be lengthened.
Returns 200 on creation; convention would be 201 Created. Tests accept current behavior.
Accepts empty items list (no validation that items is non-empty). Empty order can be persisted.
Always overwrites existing.price with new price even on increment - that may be intentional (last-paid wins) but worth confirming with product.
Not transactional - if 2nd item fails after 1st was decremented, the 1st deduction is not rolled back.

action_items: Optional: bump JWT_SECRET to >=32 bytes to silence InsecureKeyLengthWarning.
Optional: validate orders.items is non-empty in POST /api/orders.
Optional: wrap multi-item /medicines/sell in a transaction or rollback on failure.
Optional: confirm desired price-overwrite semantics in /medicines/buy when stock already exists.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is single 428-line file - acceptable for current size but consider splitting by domain (auth/medicines/suppliers) if it grows.
Password hashing uses plain sha256 (no salt). Acceptable for MVP but bcrypt/argon2 recommended for production.
/api/medicines/identify imports emergentintegrations inside the handler - works but a module-level import would surface load errors at startup.
All endpoints exclude _id from Mongo responses correctly; no ObjectId leaks observed.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per spec; browsers will reject. Fine for mobile/Expo client.
seed_data_creation: Tests register new pharmacies and suppliers with TEST_ prefix and timestamp suffix; medicines/products created during tests are deleted at end. The pre-seeded pharmacy 07700000001/pass123 was used and not modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints work: pharmacy/supplier register+login, /me, full medicines CRUD, barcode lookup, buy (increments qty for existing barcode), sell (deducts and computes total, 400 on insufficient), orders, supplier products, /marketplace (both roles), role enforcement (403 cross-role). AI /medicines/identify endpoint returned 200 on a tiny PNG with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY using gemini-3-flash-preview. JWT_SECRET is short (28 bytes) - low priority warning only. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_pharmacy_api.py. Re-run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_pharmacy_api.py -v
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. Backend implementation matches the spec in the review request.
